thought.text: GDAL 3.6.2 installed at /usr/local. Verifying headers, then re-running `poetry install`.

reasoning_content:
GDAL 3.6.2 is currently installed in /usr/local (gdal-config reports 3.6.2dev, libgdal.so.32 → 32.3.6.2). The header files in /usr/local/include/gdal should now have the 3.6.2 headers (including ogr_recordbatch.h).

Let's verify the header files, then re-run poetry install.

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "ls /usr/local/include/gdal/ogr_recordbatch.h /usr/local/include/gdal/gdal_priv.h >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -c \"GDT_UInt64\" /usr/local/include/gdal/ogr_core.h && echo HEADERS_OK", "summary": "Verify GDAL 3.6.2 headers present", "security_risk": "LOW"}
